items.title: ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework
items.summary: Laminar is an open-source asynchronous RL post-training framework from HKU and ByteDance Seed researchers. It decouples rollout, training and weight sync, and lifted Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B to 52.2% on SWE-bench Verified. The post ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Meet Facebook’s Your Algorithm: How Meta Turns Plain-Language Preferences Into Ranking
items.summary: Meta's engineering team explains how Facebook's Your Algorithm turns plain-language interests into ranking signals for Feed and Reels, using LLM validation, 4 retrieval sources, layered filtering and a fine-tuned LLM reranker. items.title: OpenAI and Cisco Releases Shirudo: An Open-Source Linux Runtime Allowing Agents to Defend Systems Without Downtime
items.summary: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a pre-release, BSD-licensed eBPF runtime for Linux. AI agents write signed "shields" that block exploit paths on running systems while teams test and roll out real patches. The post OpenAI and Cisco Releases Shirudo: An Open-Source Linux Runtime Allowing Agents to Defend Systems Without Downtime appeared first on MarkTechPost.
